result.title: Minimax-optimal Scaling Laws in Ridge Regression via Transfer Learning
result.summary: Pretrained models are often reused across downstream tasks, motivating the question of whether this transfer learning procedure can provide a substantial performance improvement, namely, in terms of the scaling law. We address this question in the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression, where (i) a pretrained \emph{source} model is trained via ridge regression, and (ii) a fine-tuned \emph{target} model is regularized via the $L_2$ distance from the source estimator. First, we establish a deterministic equivalent for the risk of this two-step procedure under both model and covariance shift. Next, by specializing the deterministic equivalent to a shared regression function and commuting power-law covariance spectra, we identify a regime where the resulting scaling law achieves the minimax-optimal exponent. Notably, in this regime, the optimal source regularization depends on source data only, indicating its universality across all targets. Furthermore, we show that the same optimal rate is achieved by performing the fine-tuning step via one-pass stochastic gradient descent. We support our theoretical analysis via experiments on both synthetic settings and language models.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在高维岭回归设定下研究「预训练源模型 + 以到源估计器的 L2 距离作正则的微调」这一两阶段迁移流程，给出风险的确定性等价，并在共享回归函数与幂律协方差谱下刻画达到极小极大最优指数的标度律区间，另证明单遍 SGD 微调可达同样速率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预训练—锚定微调」两阶段标度律与最优正则强度的理论框架，可能为 LVR 中表示复用、微调或轨迹训练该保留多少预训练状态，以及长度/任务泛化的预测性工作区提供可供核查的类比线索。
